title: Who Kratos's wife Faye really was in God of War
subject: faye
description:
Did you suspect Faye was a giant? 👇

Before she married Kratos, Faye was Laufey the Just, a Jötunn warrior who carried the Leviathan Axe. Spoilers for God of War (2018).

scenes.text: Before Faye married a Spartan, the giants called her Laufey the Just.
She was a Jötunn warrior who fought for the weak against Odin's gods.
Her weapon came from two dwarf brothers, Brok and Sindri. They called it the Leviathan Axe.
Then, in the woods of Midgard, she met a god from Greece who was hiding from his past.
They built a home, and Kratos named their son Atreus, after a Spartan he admired.
Faye never told the boy who she had been.
When she died, she left Kratos her axe and one last wish.
